about: A grid of cells shaded by their values, with named rows and columns, filling in row by row as the voice goes and the highest cell ringed: when something peaks over hours and days, places by month, groups by measure, any table of numbers seen as a pattern.

values.about: the numbers, rows split by ; and cells by commas

peakName.about: words under the grid about the peak; else its value

when.about: moments each row fills; else when its name is said, or one after another
